name: Warpriest Combat Medic
body:
A combat medic travels the battlefield aiding their allies and trying to keep them from further harm.

Combat Casting

A combat medic is adept at casting their healing spells in dire circumstances. They gain Combat Casting as a bonus feat.

This ability replaces focus weapon.

Healing Kicker (Su)

Whenever a combat medic casts a conjuration (healing) spell on an ally, they can grant one of the extra benefits shown below.

This ability is usable a number of times per day equal to 1/2 their class level plus their Wisdom modifier (minimum 1).

The effect lasts for 1 round unless otherwise noted, and only one kicker can be added per casting.

At 1st level, the combat medic can grant a healed creature the benefits of sanctuary as if they cast it on the target for DC purposes.

At 4th level, they can grant the target a bonus on Reflex saving throws equal to their class level.

At 13th level, they can grant the effects of a maximized aid spell effect. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until the temporary hit points are lost.

This ability replaces sacred weapon.

Field Healer (Ex)

At 3rd level, a combat medic can make Heal checks to perform first aid as a move action, rather than a standard action. Additionally, they can take 10 on such checks even while under duress.

This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 3rd level.

Mobility (Ex)

At 6th level, a combat medic gains Mobility as a bonus feat without needing to meet the prerequisites.

This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 6th level.

Evasion (Ex)

Beginning at 8th level, a combat medic can avoid damage from many area-effect attacks. If a combat medic makes a successful Reflex saving throw against an attack that normally deals half damage on a successful save, they instead take no damage. Evasion can be used only if the combat medic is wearing light armor or no armor. A helpless combat medic does not gain the benefit of evasion.

If the combat medic already has evasion from another class, they gain improved evasion instead.
